name: column_stack
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::column_stack(Tensor[] tensors) -> Tensor. Creates a new tensor by stacking scalar and one-dimensional inputs as columns and concatenating higher-rank inputs along dimension 1. The correctness suite retains the legacy one-, two-, mixed-, and three-dimensional cases and additionally covers scalar and zero-sized tensors, noncontiguous inputs, tuple input, dtype promotion, and invalid empty, rank, and shape combinations.
